summary: Bulletin export must emit parsed notice records from the notices domain parser, because /notices is HTML and a JSON export of the raw page is not a bulletin record.
reason: The generated export treats the notice index as JSON. JSONL would persist the HTML document and JSON decoding fails. A regen must keep bulletin export on the notice parser, follow index pagination until --limit is satisfied or the index ends, and fail closed instead of clamping --limit 0 to the notices command's 50-record window.
validated_outcome: JSON and JSONL bulletin export decode as notice records and do not contain the source HTML.
